title: Allee Effect Threshold Model: Command-Line Tool
description: Allee Effect Threshold Model built as a Command-line tool. The Allee effect makes per-capita growth negative below a critical density (mate-finding failure), creating an extinction threshold even in good habitat. The model adds a cubic term to logistic growth and finds the unstable threshold density. The simulator shows populations above it recover and below it crash. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
resume_bullet: Built a Allee Effect Threshold Model CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.

title: Phylogenetic Bootstrap Support Analyzer: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Phylogenetic Bootstrap Support Analyzer built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Bootstrapping a phylogeny resamples alignment columns with replacement, rebuilds the tree many times, and reports how often each clade recurs as support values. title: Burrows-Wheeler Transform Tool: Command-Line Tool
description: Burrows-Wheeler Transform Tool built as a Command-line tool. The Burrows-Wheeler transform reversibly permutes a string so identical characters cluster together, which is why it compresses well and powers the FM-index. Appending a terminal sentinel makes the transform invertible via the LF-mapping. The tool computes the BWT and inverts it back to prove losslessness. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.

Clonal inheritance passes the entire genome without recombination, so mutations accumulate along lineages and phylogenies are simple trees. The tracker simulates clonal expansion with neutral mutations and reconstructs lineage relationships. It contrasts diversity patterns with sexual populations. Draws a seeded synthetic sample and reports count, mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and an ASCII histogram.
resume_bullet: Built a Clonal Lineage Tracker statistical analyzer in pure Python computing mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and histograms from seeded synthetic data; prints a formatted report with an ASCII distribution plot.

title: Copy Number Variant Simulator: Data Pipeline (Etl)
description: Copy Number Variant Simulator built as a Data pipeline (ETL). Copy number variants duplicate or delete genomic segments; tandem duplications arise by non-allelic homologous recombination between repeats. The simulator generates CNV events with size distributions from empirical studies and tracks copy-number state along a chromosome. It reports CNV counts by type and size class. Extracts synthetic topic records, transforms them (drop invalid, normalize, bucket), and loads the clean set to CSV.
resume_bullet: Built a Copy Number Variant Simulator ETL pipeline in Python (stdlib csv) with extract, transform, and load stages; handles corrupt rows with drop counts and reports per-stage statistics to the console.

title: Coalescent Genealogy Simulator: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Coalescent Genealogy Simulator built as a Simulation (logistic growth). The coalescent traces gene copies backward in time: pairs merge at rate depending on population size, and mutations fall on branches as a Poisson process. Simulating genealogies this way is far cheaper than forward simulation. The tool generates trees, overlays mutations, and reports pairwise diversity. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: Two-Species Competition Model: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Two-Species Competition Model built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Lotka-Volterra competition extends the predator-prey form with competition coefficients alpha: each species inhibits itself and its rival. Four outcomes are possible: exclusion either way, unstable priority effects, or stable coexistence when intraspecific competition exceeds interspecific. The simulator maps outcomes across parameter space. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
resume_bullet: Built a Two-Species Competition Model simulator in Python (stdlib) implementing Euler integration of logistic growth with seeded parameters; demo runs end-to-end and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

The simulator draws founder samples and tracks diversity loss over subsequent generations. It compares heterozygosity in founders versus source. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
resume_bullet: Built a Founder Effect Simulator simulator in Python (stdlib) implementing Euler integration of logistic growth with seeded parameters; demo runs end-to-end and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: Gibbs Sampling Motif Finder: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Gibbs Sampling Motif Finder built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Gibbs sampling discovers motifs by iteratively removing one sequence's motif instance and resampling its position proportional to how well each window matches the motif model built from the others. Repeated iterations converge on overrepresented patterns. The sampler reports the motif logo heights and instance positions. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: Genomic Imprinting Pedigree Model: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Genomic Imprinting Pedigree Model built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Imprinted genes express only the paternal or maternal copy, so the same allele causes disease only when inherited from a specific parent. The pedigree model tracks parent-of-origin for each transmission and predicts affected status accordingly. It explains pedigrees that defy Mendelian expectations. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: Lac Operon Logic Model: Quiz Engine
description: Lac Operon Logic Model built as a quiz engine. The lac operon switches lactose metabolism on only when lactose is present and glucose absent: the repressor blocks transcription until allolactose binds it, and CAP activates only at low glucose. The model is a Boolean/logic gate combining both signals. It predicts expression across the four nutrient conditions. A multiple-choice quiz engine that shuffles options deterministically, scores auto-answered or interactive sessions, and assigns letter grades.
resume_bullet: Built a Lac Operon Logic Model in Python with deterministic option shuffling, auto and interactive answering modes, and letter-grade scoring.

title: Leslie Matrix Population Projector: Linear Regression
description: Leslie Matrix Population Projector built as a Linear regression. A Leslie matrix projects an age-structured population: fecundities on the top row, survivorships on the subdiagonal. The dominant eigenvalue is the asymptotic growth rate lambda and its eigenvector the stable age distribution. The projector iterates the matrix and reports transient versus asymptotic dynamics. Fits y = slope*x + intercept by closed-form least squares on seeded synthetic data and reports coefficients, R^2, and predictions.
resume_bullet: Built a Leslie Matrix Population Projector linear regression in pure Python implementing closed-form least squares on seeded synthetic data; demo recovers known coefficients and reports R^2 with a prediction table.

title: Lethal Allele Equilibrium Calculator: Command-Line Tool
description: Lethal Allele Equilibrium Calculator built as a Command-line tool. description: Microtubule Dynamic Instability Simulator built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Stem cells choose fates at branch points: self-renewal versus differentiation into lineage-committed progeny, with probabilities set by niche signals. The branching-process simulator tracks lineage trees and clone-size distributions. It predicts how signal shifts change tissue composition. Serves a single-page HTML dashboard of topic metrics plus a JSON metrics endpoint.
resume_bullet: Built a Stem Cell Lineage Branching Simulator web dashboard in Python (stdlib http.server) rendering a server-side HTML metrics table with a JSON API; default run self-tests both endpoints on 127.0.0.1 and prints verification results.

title: Succession Markov Simulator: Quiz Engine
description: Succession Markov Simulator built as a quiz engine. Ecological succession moves a community through pioneer, intermediate, and climax stages as species modify conditions for their successors. A Markov transition model captures stage probabilities over time. The simulator runs the chain and reports expected time to climax and stage occupancy. A multiple-choice quiz engine that shuffles options deterministically, scores auto-answered or interactive sessions, and assigns letter grades.
resume_bullet: Built a Succession Markov Simulator in Python with deterministic option shuffling, auto and interactive answering modes, and letter-grade scoring.

title: Succession Markov Simulator: Simulation (Logistic Growth)

title: Synteny Block Chainer: Command-Line Tool
description: Synteny Block Chainer built as a Command-line tool. Synteny blocks are runs of orthologous genes in conserved order between genomes, revealed by chaining collinear hits from a dot plot. Inversions and translocations break the blocks. The finder chains seeded diagonal matches into blocks with gap penalties and reports block coordinates and orientations. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
resume_bullet: Built a Synteny Block Chainer CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.

title: Tajima's D Neutrality Tester: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Tajima's D Neutrality Tester built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Tajima's D compares two estimators of mutation rate: pairwise diversity versus segregating sites; negative values signal population expansion or selective sweeps, positive values signal balancing selection or bottlenecks. The statistic normalizes their difference by its theoretical variance. The calculator reports D and an approximate significance flag. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
resume_bullet: Built a Tajima's D Neutrality Tester simulator in Python (stdlib) implementing Euler integration of logistic growth with seeded parameters; demo runs end-to-end and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: Tandem Repeat Finder: Command-Line Tool
description: Tandem Repeat Finder built as a Command-line tool. Variant effect classifiers sort variants into categories (synonymous, missense, nonsense, splice-region) using rule-based decision logic on codon changes and position context. A small decision tree learns the mapping from labeled examples and explains each prediction as a rule path. It reports class distributions over a VCF. Extracts synthetic topic records, transforms them (drop invalid, normalize, bucket), and loads the clean set to CSV.
resume_bullet: Built a Variant Effect Decision-Tree Classifier ETL pipeline in Python (stdlib csv) with extract, transform, and load stages; handles corrupt rows with drop counts and reports per-stage statistics to the console.

title: VCF Stats Reporter: Command-Line Tool
description: VCF Stats Reporter built as a Command-line tool. VCF files record variants with chromosome, position, reference and alternate alleles, quality, and genotype fields; summary statistics reveal call-set quality. The reporter counts variant types (SNP, indel), transition-transversion ratio, missingness per sample, and allele-frequency spectra. It flags low-quality and multiallelic records. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
resume_bullet: Built a VCF Stats Reporter CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.

title: Vesicle Trafficking Simulator: Data Pipeline (Etl)
description: Vesicle Trafficking Simulator built as a Data pipeline (ETL). Vesicles bud from donor membranes, diffuse or ride motors, then fuse with targets via SNARE pairing; each step has rates governing cargo delivery. The trafficking simulator models vesicle populations moving between organelle compartments. It reports steady-state cargo distribution and delivery times. Extracts synthetic topic records, transforms them (drop invalid, normalize, bucket), and loads the clean set to CSV.

title: Wound Healing Scratch Assay Simulator: Simulation (Logistic Growth)

title: Wright-Fisher Drift Simulator: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Wright-Fisher Drift Simulator built as a Simulation (logistic growth). The Wright-Fisher model samples 2N gene copies each generation from the previous one, so allele frequencies wander by drift with variance p(1-p)/2N per generation. Small populations fix or lose alleles quickly. The simulator tracks allele trajectories, time to fixation, and heterozygosity decay. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
resume_bullet: Built a Wright-Fisher Drift Simulator simulator in Python (stdlib) implementing Euler integration of logistic growth with seeded parameters; demo runs end-to-end and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: X-Linked Pedigree Solver: Quiz Engine
description: X-Linked Pedigree Solver built as a quiz engine. X-linked traits show criss-cross inheritance: fathers pass X to daughters only, so affected fathers have carrier daughters and affected sons inherit from carrier mothers. The solver computes transmission probabilities through a pedigree and flags obligate carriers. It handles X-linked dominant and recessive separately. A multiple-choice quiz engine that shuffles options deterministically, scores auto-answered or interactive sessions, and assigns letter grades.
resume_bullet: Built a X-Linked Pedigree Solver in Python with deterministic option shuffling, auto and interactive answering modes, and letter-grade scoring.
